risks.risk: Shutter count could be far higher than claimed, affecting shutter life/value.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the camera's shooting-data menu or a shutter-count app reading showing actuations.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a well-used body with high, unknown actuation count

risks.risk: Lens glass may have fungus, haze, or scratches hidden by the caps.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the front and rear lens elements with caps removed, lens held up to light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a lens with possible optical defects

risks.risk: Sensor could have dust, scratches, or hot pixels.
risks.proof: Photo of the sensor with lens removed, and a test shot of a plain white/blue sky showing no spots.
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor condition unknown/risk of defects

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or EVF/LCD may be faulty.
risks.proof: Short video of the camera powering on, showing live view on both LCD and EVF, and a test shutter actuation.

risks.risk: Mismatched or non-functional body/lens pairing, or stolen goods (no serial check possible).
risks.proof: Photo of the body serial number plate and a matching purchase receipt or box.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified provenance, no premium for authenticity

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, showing LCD/EVF live view and a successful shutter press.
Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or a shutter-count checking app.
Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements without caps, under good light.
Photo of the sensor with the lens detached.
Photo of the body's serial number plate (usually on the base) for identity confirmation.
response.reason: The seller's reply adds no new visual evidence, only a verbal reassurance, so the claims about shutter count, lens condition, and working state remain unverified; the item is still priced at its worst-case condition as previously assessed.
